missingness_source: bootstrap of real per-patient full 142-item observed/missing masks from data/processed/baseline_v0.parquet (the model's own input frame, 9013 patients); only the binary observed/missing indicator is used, never any clinical value
projection_scheme: Fisher-scoring (expected-information Gauss-Newton / Laplace) EAP. Posterior precision S^-1 = Phi^-1 + sum_{j obs} w_j(eta) lam_j lam_j^T with per-item expected Fisher info w_j (gaussian 1/sigma^2; bernoulli p(1-p); count mu*r/(r+mu); ordinal graded-response sum_k dP_k^2/P_k), posterior mean by Newton iteration on the penalized score g = -Phi^-1 theta + sum_{j obs} s_j(eta) lam_j. Reduces EXACTLY (verified to 3e-15) to the paper's closed-form conditional_gaussian_scores on all-gaussian observed patterns; the Newton/Laplace step generalises it to the non-gaussian families. Prior Phi = frozen model's factor_prior (G and substance orthogonal); scored on the model-internal (rank-INT/copula-z) scale.
phi_note: reports/copula_8factor_phi.csv differs from the frozen model Phi by <=0.11 on specific off-diagonals; the calibration test uses the frozen model's own Phi so generation and scoring share one prior (self-consistent by construction).
scale: model-internal (gaussian channel on rank-INT/copula-z scale; discrete on native code)
notes: Coverage measured as fraction with |theta_true-mean| <= z*posterior_sd per axis; joint via Mahalanobis under posterior cov vs chi2_8. Sanity: coverage in [0,1], monotone in nominal, and 0-observed (prior-dominated) axes recover ~nominal coverage by construction (prior in, prior out). Posterior SD runs modestly below residual RMSE on discrete-informed axes (per-axis sd/rmse ratio 0.90-1.01; lowest suicidality 0.895, mania/substance at parity 1.007/0.996) - a light-tailed Laplace-Gaussian approximation - yet 95%-level coverage is exact because it is set by the interval quantiles, not the SD.
